statement: The actual morphism h=(x+y)/(x+zeta y) gives a surjective arithmetic quotient from the cubic intrinsic pro-three class-three group to the rank-two free class-three group. Its genuine based Galois action and full arithmetic image are computed exactly in terms of chi and kappa_a, a=zeta(1-zeta)^(-3). The exact tangential root transport gives an evaluated Frobenius4 action. Explicit Hall polynomials determine every local class-two section in the image of the class-three section map at K_2; all nonempty fibers have81 elements.

notes: The actual h-induced map is proved surjective by independent geometric Kummer characters and the closed-image Frattini argument. Its exact class-three kernel is h_*^{-1}(gamma4 F)/gamma4 N.
The formal punctured-disc path cocycle is x^{kappa_a} before truncation. The arithmetic comparison (w,g)->(w x^{kappa_a(g)},g) and its inverse are given.
The positive coefficient (chi^2-1)/24 is derived from the actual three-cycle convention. The integral Hall law has only denominators2 and is valid at the prime3 without a BCH division by3.
The full arithmetic image is Gamma_a={(chi,k):chi in1+3Z3, k=(chi-1)/3 mod3}. Its kernel over chi is3Z3, proved by the Kummer image of lambda over the cyclotomic field.
The direct Teichmuller root system at2 has kappa_a(Frob4)=1. The assembled lambda-root system has -5. Their exact ratio zeta_(3^n)^2 yields the conjugacy Ad(x^-2) alpha_old Ad(x^2)=alpha_new.

The full local image criterion uses the exact tame relation and the central operator64-4=60. Its obstruction is (Z/3)^2 and its successful geometric-conjugacy fibers are (Z/9)^2; the lower stabilizer vanishes by the positive Frobenius weights.

The local target lower section with inertia y and Frobenius x^-1 is obstructed. Replacing Frobenius by x^-1 c gives the explicit class-three lift with inertia y e^(1/40). These target classes share their abelian coordinates.
The commutative intrinsic-to-target obstruction maps and the exact geometric kernel are retained. The result does not assume that every target lower section has an intrinsic preimage.
